source_text: Ὅσα δεῖ βιβλία ἀναγινώσκεσθαι τῆς Παλαιᾶς Διαθήκης· α' Γένεσις κόσμου· β' Ἔξοδος ἐξ Αἰγύπτου· γ' Λευϊτικὸν· δ' Ἀριθμοί· ε' Δευτερονόμιον· ς' Ἰησοῦς τοῦ Ναυῆ· ζ' Κριταί, Ῥούθ· η' Ἐσθήρ· θ' Βασιλειῶν πρώτη καὶ δευτέρα· ι' Βασιλειῶν τρίτη καὶ τετάρτη· ια' Παραλειπομένων πρῶτον καὶ δεύτερον· ιβ' Ἔσδρας πρῶτον καὶ δεύτερον· ιγ' Βίβλος Ψαλμῶν ρν'· ιδ' Παροιμίαι Σολομῶντος· ιε' Ἐκκλησιαστής· ις' Ἆσμα ᾀσμάτων· ιζ' Ἰώβ· ιη' Δωδεκαπρόφητον· ιθ' Ἡσαΐας· κ' Ἱερεμίας καὶ Βαρούχ, Θρῆνοι καὶ ἐπιστολαί· κα' Ἰεζεκιήλ· κβ' Δανιήλ. Τὰ δὲ τῆς Καινῆς Διαθήκης ταῦτα· Εὐαγγέλια τέσσαρα, κατὰ Ματθαῖον, κατὰ Μάρκον, κατὰ Λουκᾶν, κατὰ Ἰωάννην· Πράξεις Ἀποστόλων· Ἐπιστολαὶ καθολικαὶ ἑπτά, Ἰακώβου μία, Πέτρου δύο, Ἰωάννου τρεῖς, Ἰούδα μία· Ἐπιστολαὶ Παύλου δεκατέσσαρες· πρὸς Ρωμαίους μία, πρὸς Κορινθίους δύο, πρὸς Γαλάτας μία, πρὸς Ἐφεσίους μία, πρὸς Φιλιππησίους μία, πρὸς Κολοσσαεῖς μία, πρὸς Θεσσαλονικεῖς δύο, πρὸς Ἑβραίους μία, πρὸς Τιμόθεον δύο, πρὸς Τίτον μία, καὶ πρὸς Φιλήμονα μία.
thought_title: The Canonical Books of the Old and New Testaments
orientation: The Council of Laodicea closes its canons by listing the books of the Old and New Testaments that are to be read in church.
pass_a_gloss: Which books of the Old Covenant must be read: 1 Genesis of the world; 2 Exodus from Egypt; 3 Leviticus; 4 Numbers; 5 Deuteronomy; 6 Joshua of Nave; 7 Judges, Ruth; 8 Esther; 9 of Kingdoms first and second; 10 of Kingdoms third and fourth; 11 of Paralipomenon first and second; 12 Esdras first and second; 13 Book of Psalms 150; 14 Proverbs of Solomon; 15 Ecclesiastes; 16 Song of Songs; 17 Job; 18 Twelve Prophets; 19 Isaiah; 20 Jeremiah and Baruch, Lamentations and epistles; 21 Ezekiel; 22 Daniel. And the books of the New Covenant are these: four Gospels, according to Matthew, according to Mark, according to Luke, according to John; Acts of Apostles; seven catholic epistles, of James one, of Peter two, of John three, of Jude one; fourteen epistles of Paul: to Romans one, to Corinthians two, to Galatians one, to Ephesians one, to Philippians one, to Colossians one, to Thessalonians two, to Hebrews one, to Timothy two, to Titus one, and to Philemon one.

choices.why: The source uses 'covenant' (διαθήκη), not 'testament'; the brief's scripture note uses covenant language, so I keep the literal covenant term.
The brief's name map gives 'Joshua' for 'Jesus son of Nave'; I render the source form literally as 'Joshua of Nave' to preserve the Greek naming.
The source uses the Septuagint book name 'Kingdoms'; the brief maps these to 1-2 Samuel and 1-2 Kings in modern citations, but the literal translation keeps 'Kingdoms'.
The source uses the Septuagint name; the brief maps it to Chronicles for modern citations, but the literal rendering keeps the Greek term.
The source uses 'Esdras'; the brief maps this to Ezra-Nehemiah for modern citations, but the literal rendering keeps the Greek name.
The numeral ρν' means 150; I render it as a number to preserve the source's count of psalms.

pass_b_english: The books that are to be read from the Old Covenant are these: first, Genesis of the world; second, Exodus from Egypt; third, Leviticus; fourth, Numbers; fifth, Deuteronomy; sixth, Joshua of Nave; seventh, Judges, Ruth; eighth, Esther; ninth, of Kingdoms first and second; tenth, of Kingdoms third and fourth; eleventh, Chronicles first and second; twelfth, Ezra-Nehemiah first and second; thirteenth, the Book of Psalms, 150; fourteenth, Proverbs of Solomon; fifteenth, Ecclesiastes; sixteenth, Song of Songs; seventeenth, Job; eighteenth, the Minor Prophets; nineteenth, Isaiah; twentieth, Jeremiah and Baruch, Lamentations and epistles; twenty-first, Ezekiel; twenty-second, Daniel. The books of the New Covenant are these: four Gospels, according to Matthew, according to Mark, according to Luke, according to John; the Acts of the Apostles; seven catholic epistles—one of James, two of Peter, three of John, one of Jude; fourteen epistles of Paul—one to the Romans, two to the Corinthians, one to the Galatians, one to the Ephesians, one to the Philippians, one to the Colossians, two to the Thessalonians, one to the Hebrews, two to Timothy, one to Titus, and one to Philemon.
